layers.message: Add record store, roles, and GET /records
Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records

graderOnly: The export_file_name docstring in records/export.py is wrong: it says the file is named records-YYYY-MM-DD.csv from the local date of now, so same-day exports share one file; the code names it records-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ.csv from the UTC time of now, to the second. Correcting the docstring is a documentation-only change Documenter owns.

The comment `# type: ignore[union-attr]` on the line right after that docstring is wrong: now is annotated as a non-optional datetime, so there is no union attribute access to suppress. pyproject.toml configures mypy with strict = true and warn_unused_ignores = true, so mypy reports the comment as an unused ignore; changing or removing it changes type-checking results. It is a tooling directive, i.e. implementation owned by Developer (IMPLEMENTATION).
mypy is not installed in the runner and PyPI is blocked, so neither earlier roles nor the Documenter can run the type check.
docs/usage.md has no export section yet; AC-002 requires one. The implementation otherwise satisfies AC-001, and all other docstrings in the export code are accurate.

notes: Standalone Python fixture (the export-documenting base is TypeScript; the case needs a Python docstring and a type-ignore directive). Two pre-install commits: 00-project (stdlib Python records service: store, filters, auth, http router, GET /records, seed, 15 pytest tests, pyproject with pytest config and strict mypy config including warn_unused_ignores) and 05-docs (docs/usage.md with listing docs and no export section; README links it). Post-install commits follow the brownfield order for cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2: 20-context (CONTEXT.md, notes mypy configured but not installed and index unreachable; STATE SCOPING), 25-scope (AC-001 CSV export behavior with admin-only server-side authorization; AC-002 accurate usage guide in docs/usage.md; STATE ARCHITECTING), 30-design (POST /records/export contract, file name records-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.csv from UTC now(); AC-002 No architectural impact; STATE DEVELOPING), 35-plan (APPROVED plan, 3 PENDING steps), 40-export (records/export.py, records/export_route.py, app.py options, .gitignore exports/, 10 tests), 42-complete (plan COMPLETE with self-checks citing the implementation commit; STATE TESTING), 46-verification (COMPLETE FULL report, AC-001 verified, AC-002 pending Documenter; STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION), 48-review (COMPLETE IMPLEMENTATION review, no material findings, AC-002 permitted dependency; STATE DOCUMENTING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION). The wrong docstring and the wrong `# type: ignore[union-attr]` directive sit together in export_file_name in records/export.py. Earlier records note that mypy could not be run, which is why the stale directive went unnoticed. Recovery and obligations are inactive, BlockedOn NONE, tree clean.
